title: Corporate Egg-spionage
start: Talk to the Easter Bunny in the Blooming Burrow.

recommended.t: Access to the Port Sarim lodestone

rewards.t: Emotes from previous Easter events (if not already unlocked)
Access to the Intel Eggstraction activity in the Blooming Burrow

steps.t: Talk to the Easter Bunny outside their house in the Blooming Burrow. [Chat: 1 Do you have a quest for me? › Accept]
p: The Easter Bunny outside his home in the Blooming Burrow

steps.t: Go to the Egg Plant on the western side of the burrow and talk to either the Easter Bunny, Angus Almond, Carmilla Caramel, or Chad Berry.
Talk to the Easter Bunny just north.
Just outside of the Egg Plant, north-east of Nougat Bunny's stall, confront the Suspicious Rabbit.
p: The Suspicious Rabbit near the Grand Eggs-change

steps.t: Go east by passing the two bridges and then midway south (north of the Thieving icons on the map) and confront the Loitering Hare.
Go all the way south-east and confront the Odd Jackrabbit from behind.
Talk to Count Rivance outside of Gerrant's Fishy Business at the eastern wall.
p: The Loitering Hare hanging around the beehives
The Odd Jackrabbit on the edge of the Blooming Burrow
Count Rivance standing near the Port Sarim lodestone

steps.t: Talk to the Easter Bunny. [Chat: 1 Yes!]

Talk to either Angus Almond, Carmilla Caramel, or Chad Berry. [Chat: 1 Carmilla has been replacing your gold with chocolate coins! › 2 You pay your employees overtime! › 2 You've been cooking the books! › 3 You have an almond allergy!]
p: The spies inside the factory of the Blooming Burrow

get_inside.text: Land of Glades
Easter Bunny's burrow
The following teleports lead to the northern island with Easter Bunny's house:
Blooming Burrow entry in the Calendar interface
Blooming Burrow Teleport in any Magic spellbook or via the Lodestone Network for the first time
Holiday portal in Prifddinas
Town criers
The following teleports lead to the western island with the Egg Plant:
Entering the Blooming Burrow portal in the event hub north of the Grand Exchange in Varrock
Blooming Burrow Teleport in any Magic spellbook or via the Lodestone Network after the first time
Event noticeboards
Button in the Event tab in the Community interface
Tree of Balance
Beehives
The beehives in the southern part of Blooming Burrow are used in the beekeeping activity for Farming.
Easter Bunny's house
Easter Bunny's house is located in the northern part of Blooming Burrow. Easter Bunny lives there, and the burrow leads here. The house features a cooking range.
Egg Plant

The Egg Plant is a factory that can be found in the western part of Blooming Burrow. It features two skilling activities: foil smithing and factory line, which is unlocked upon completing the seasonal Great Egg-spectations quest.
The two reward shops and the bank chest in the area are located outside the Egg Plant.
Farm
The farm in the southern part of Blooming Burrow features Fizzy Bunny who can be used to hand in chocolate rabbits as part of the cocoamancy activity.
Mines
The mines in the south-western part of Blooming Burrow can be used for the chocolate mining activity. The mine produces chocolate for the Egg Plant factory.
